principles: view models project canonical entities; they never invent alternate lifecycle semantics
complexity follows commitment: briefing -> opportunity review -> research -> workspace
gesture is an input adapter; canonical action is the contract
candidate-facing recommendation remains distinct from candidate disposition
internal enum names and machine-state vocabulary are not default user-facing copy
user-facing actions must be coherent with the current canonical state
a briefing surface is a decision queue and must not duplicate the full opportunity workspace
a small shortlist is directly visible inside Opportunities and supports comparison without forced pagination
qualitative assessments are expressed through concrete evidence and uncertainty rather than decorative metric cards or pseudo-precise scores
researcher instrumentation is not part of candidate-facing product UI
comparison presents named decision dimensions and source-backed uncertainty; it must not collapse opportunities into one opaque winner score
top-level navigation is not required to mirror backend domain boundaries
pursuit workspace composition is stage-aware while canonical object/state semantics remain unchanged

views.name: Candidate Briefing
invariants: briefing shows temporal work that needs attention now rather than repeating the opportunity catalog
an attention event can project opportunity, interaction, commitment, relationship or selection context
no motivational greeting or decorative personalized filler is required
no automatic apply

views.name: Opportunity Shortlist
invariants: shortlist is explicitly visible within the Opportunities surface
desktop supports list comparison and detail inspection without forced one-card pagination
raw canonical state labels are mapped to natural candidate-facing language

views.name: Opportunity Comparison
invariants: comparison is user-invoked and does not mutate opportunity state
shortlist membership remains independent from candidate disposition
comparison makes trade-offs inspectable without declaring an automatic winner

views.name: Opportunity List Row
invariants: candidate can scan multiple opportunities as rows rather than isolated dashboard cards
opening a row for inspection does not itself imply external action

views.name: Opportunity Review
invariants: supported assertions show source and observation context without exposing raw internal object vocabulary
open questions make decision impact inspectable
relationship facts remain visually distinct from access-route assessment
research detail appears progressively when the candidate chooses to spend more attention
candidate activation of a pursuit workspace is explicit and does not apply, submit, share, or contact anyone

views.name: Mandate Evidence Binding
invariants: binding never upgrades evidence status

views.name: Opportunity Workspace
invariants: workspace is a working file for one live opportunity, not a generic dashboard
candidate-facing navigation composes canonical domains into Brief, People, Positioning, Process and Record
workspace composition changes with pre-contact, recruiter, selection, final/reference and offer context while navigation remains stable
offer content is not shown as an empty permanent module before it becomes relevant
workspace activation itself has no external effect

views.name: Career Evidence Review
invariants: attest is not verify
AI proposal is visibly distinct from candidate attestation

views.name: Resume Variant Review
invariants: approve is not share/apply

views.name: Selection Preparation
invariants: stakeholder hypotheses remain labeled inference unless evidence-backed

views.name: Debrief Review
invariants: debrief extraction does not silently commit known facts

views.name: Offer Decision
invariants: candidate intent is not external acceptance/decline
AI never selects intent action

views.name: Career Strategy Intelligence
invariants: small-sample signal is not deterministic career prescription
